item.title: Explore the world with Dream Yacht’s newest yachts
item.description: Embark on an adventure of a lifetime with Dream Yacht Worldwide, where the allure of distant shores meets the appeal of exciting new yacht models, freshly-delivered to our charter bases around the world. Our newest yachts are ready to take you to some of the most breathtaking destinations on the planet. From the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean to the pristine islands of the Bahamas, we’re constantly renewing our fleet with modern charter yachts from premium brands. Let’s dive into the far corners of the world and discover some of our newest additions. Fethiye, Turkey – Bali Catspace Trogir, Croatia – Lagoon 40 Exumas, Bahamas – Lagoon 46 Kotor, Montenegro – Excess 11 Naples, Italy – Lagoon 46 Cote D’Azur, France – Excess 14 Fethiye, Turkey: Sail into History with the Bali Catspace Nestled along the Turquoise Coast, Fethiye is a haven for history enthusiasts and nature lovers alike. Start your sailing vacation in Turkey from our marina in Fethiye, perfectly situated on the Gulf of Fethiye in the ‘Turkish Riviera’. A new Bali Catspace sailing catamaran will ensure comfort and convenience for your group with interior spaces and outdoor lounge areas that make it feel much larger than her 40-feet. Sail through the crystal-clear waters of Göcek Bay, where ancient Lycian tombs stand as silent sentinels. Anchor in Kapi Creek, a scenic must-visit anchorage where you can moor at the jetty to swim at the nearby beach, explore Merdivenli Cove and Seagull Bay, or hike the hills to discover ancient ruins.Then, sail to Ekincik and take a motorboat ride up the Dalyan River to the ancient city of Kaunos, where you’ll see six tombs of the kings cut into the sheer rock face. The Bali Catspace, with its innovative salon that opens fully to the outdoors, is the perfect platform for exploring this enchanting region. Whether you’re seeking adventure or relaxation, Fethiye and the Bali Catspace offer an unforgettable experience. Trogir, Croatia: Discover the Adriatic with the Lagoon 40 Start your charter in breathtaking Trogir , a UNESCO World Heritage site where you can walk through the walled city and visit gothic cathedrals. Then set sail through the picturesque islands of the Dalmatian archipelago, where ancient towns and lush vineyards await. The Lagoon 40, known for its stability and performance, is an ideal choice for exploring the dramatic Croatian coastline. Spacious outdoor areas and comfortable cabins will provide the perfect setting for a memorable vacation. Croatia’s coastline is a tapestry of natural beauty and historical significance. Visit the island of Hvar, famous for its lavender fields and vibrant nightlife. Sail to nearby Vis to discover the historic town’s stone buildings, including Garibaldi Palace, as well as its many shops and restaurants. The Lagoon 40’s efficient sail plan and modern amenities will ensure a smooth and enjoyable Croatia sailing experience for memories of a lifetime! Exumas, Bahamas: Paradise Found with the Lagoon 46 The Exumas, a string of 365 islands, is a natural paradise waiting to be explored. Sail through the brilliant turquoise waters of the Bahamas, where pristine beaches and crystal-clear lagoons await. The Lagoon 46 features a spacious interior layout and premium amenities – perfect for friends and family to enjoy this idyllic destination. The Exumas are famous for their natural wonders, including the famous swimming pigs of Big Major Cay. Staniel Cay, where you’ll find the beautiful grotto seen in the James Bond movie Thunderball, is another highlight of any Exuma yacht charter. The Lagoon 46’s larger size with spacious elevated flybridge make it ideal for groups of friends and family to enjoy an extended sailing vacation in the Exumas . Whether you’re seeking adventure or relaxation, the Exumas and the Lagoon 46 offer an unforgettable experience. item.title: New BALI Catamarans arriving in the Seychelles
item.description: As Dream Yacht’s first base location and founding sailing destination nearly 25 years ago, the Seychelles Islands hold a place of honor in the hearts and minds of our Dream Yacht Worldwide charter team. Now we’re pleased to announce the arrival of two brand new catamarans soon to be available for charter in this very special island paradise. The new yachts, BALI 4.4 and BALI 4.6 catamarans, are now in transit arriving in December and available for charters from December 14, 2024. BALI yachts are one of our most sought-after charter brands, making these new 2024 “Super Premier” catamarans an exciting addition to our Seychelles fleet. About the new BALI Catamarans The BALI 4.4 is a 44-foot 4-cabin/4-bath catamaran, perfect for families or groups of friends up to 10 people. The 5-cabin/4-bath BALI 4.6 is 46-feet, and is well-suited for larger groups or for allowing space for a hired skipper. Both yachts feature the popular “garage-door” style pivoting door that creates an open air salon that lends itself to comfortable indoor/outdoor living. Both yachts also feature spacious flybridge lounge areas for comfortable seating with a view while underway, or for sunset gatherings. Sailing the Seychelles Islands We began our first Dream Yacht charters in the Seychelles for good reason. This Indian Ocean Island chain is arguably one of the most beautiful sailing grounds on the planet, with 41 of the earth’s oldest granite islands and 74 low-lying islands surrounded by brilliant blue waters and pristine reefs. For nature lovers, the bird watching, hiking, and snorkeling are unmatched. And a visit to the protected island of Curieuse to observe the gentle giant Aldabra tortoises and unique coco de mer palms is a must. Underscoring Dream Yacht’s strong commitment to delivering top sailing opportunities in the beautiful Seychelles, we will welcome additional BALI yachts – 2 BALI 4.8 catamarans – in the Seychelles late in 2025. Plan now for your dream Seychelles sailing vacation to secure one of these stunning new sailing catamarans. Get in touch with a Dream Yacht charter planner today! Share: Link Copied to Clipboard
